mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EOS_PRODUCT_LFC l JOIN TB_EOS_PRODUCT_VER v ON v.VERSION_ID = l.VERSION_ID JOIN TB_EOS_PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_ID = v.PRODUCT_ID
SELECT LFC_ID FROM TB_EOS_PRODUCT_LFC WHERE VERSION_ID = #{versionId} AND EFFECTIVE_TO_DTM IS NULL FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT RESOURCE_ID, EOS_STATUS_CD FROM TB_EOS_RESOURCE WHERE VERSION_ID = #{versionId} AND DISPOSE_YN = 'N'
SELECT POLICY_VAL FROM TB_EOS_POLICY WHERE POLICY_TYPE_CD = #{policyTypeCd} AND POLICY_KEY = #{policyKey} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND EFFECTIVE_TO_DTM IS NULL FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
